# Scania Cottages

> Scania Cottages showcases two independently owned vacation rental cottages in Skåne, Sweden — booked directly through Airbnb and Booking.com. This site is a photo-rich showcase for each property, not a booking platform itself.

## Properties

- [Bälinge Lakehouse](https://l14mo5tm4n.github.io/Airbnb_Property_Showcase-StaticWebPage/): Lake cottage with private pier, rowing boat and 1 400 m² garden in Perstorp, Skåne. Up to 4 guests, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom.
- [Little Pinecone Lodge](https://l14mo5tm4n.github.io/Airbnb_Property_Showcase-StaticWebPage/sodra-rorum/): Forest cottage with garden annex, fireplace and 2 000 m² grounds in Södra Rörum, Hörby, Skåne. Up to 5 guests.

## Optional

- [Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.com): Platform used for direct bookings of both properties.
- [Booking.com](https://www.booking.com): Platform used for direct bookings of both properties.
